# perception environment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:perceptionEnvironment`](gmeow-perceptionEnvironment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/perceptionEnvironment>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

The [`SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) that a [`SensoryPerception`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryPerception.md) is about — the [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) of the claim. Domain is [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) so it applies to any observation subclass; the shape narrows to [`SensoryPerception`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryPerception.md) instances.
